mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, c1.C_Name as dcConstruName, c2.C_Name as dcSuperviName, c3.C_Name as dcDesignName, c1.C_Abbreviation as dcConstruAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as dcSuperviAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as dcDesignAbbName, mn.* from Design_Completed mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Dc_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Dc_Constru_Unit left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.Dc_Supervi_Unit left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id=mn.Dc_Design_Unit where mn.Dc_Id=#{dcId}
